title: Agents: hosts, containers and services
description: host.agent: the monitoring agent's host or container, the containers it watches, probes and services (postgres, redis, nginx, php-fpm, elasticsearch, node.js).

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.query: SELECT tenant_name AS __text, tenant_id::text AS __value FROM devices_v GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT tenant_name AS __text, tenant_id::text AS __value FROM devices_v GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

list.name: check
list.label: Agent
list.query:
SELECT device_name || ' / ' || name AS __text, check_id::text AS __value
  FROM check_states_v WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND plugin IN ('host.agent') ORDER BY 1
list.definition:

targets.rawSql:
SELECT device_name AS device, name AS agent, labels->>'kind' AS kind, name AS object, status, last_output
  FROM check_objects_v
 WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND check_id IN ($check) AND gone_at IS NULL AND status <> 'OK'
 ORDER BY status DESC, device_name, name

SELECT device_name AS device, name AS name, labels->>'kind' AS kind, labels->>'image' AS image, status, last_output
  FROM check_objects_v
 WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND check_id IN ($check) AND gone_at IS NULL AND (object_key = 'host' OR object_key LIKE 'container:%')
 ORDER BY device_name, name

SELECT device_name AS device, name AS name, labels->>'kind' AS kind, labels->>'service' AS service, status, last_output
  FROM check_objects_v
 WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND check_id IN ($check) AND gone_at IS NULL AND (object_key LIKE 'service:%' OR object_key LIKE 'http:%' OR object_key LIKE 'tcp:%' OR object_key LIKE 'process:%')
 ORDER BY device_name, name

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (avg(value)) AS value
  FROM metrics_raw m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'cpu_usage_pct' AND m.object = 'host' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms < 300000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL

 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'replication_lag_seconds' AND m.object LIKE 'service:%' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms >= 300000 AND $__interval_ms < 3600000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (sum(sum) / sum(count)) AS value
  FROM metrics_1h m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'replication_lag_seconds' AND m.object LIKE 'service:%' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms >= 3600000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
